{{Top|leg}}
'''Infrared gates''' were specially designed security measures that were built in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|spice mines]] of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] after [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] took ownership of the facility. The gates were intended to limit contact between the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and the [[energy spider]]s that produced the [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]]. This served the dual purpose of ensuring the miner's safety since the spiders would eat other living beings, and protecting the spiders since the invasion into their natural habitat caused a sharp decrease in their numbers, requiring them to be designated as a protected [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
